summary: Iteration 10 testing complete. Backend: new test_iter10.py (11/11 passed) verifies performer_type on treatments, capacity-aware booking (slot=1 blocks 2nd, slot=2 allows 2 blocks 3rd, public POST 409), performer_id cross-clinic validation (400), and manager role can create bookings. Frontend: Treatments page renders as table with all required data-testids (treatments-table, treatment-row-{id}, treatment-performer-{id} showing 'Doctor'/'Therapist', treatment-edit/toggle/delete-{id}), edit modal has treatment-performer-type dropdown. New Booking modal has full 2-step flow with all 14 expected testids; performer filtering works correctly — Signature Facial shows only 'Lisa Therapist (therapist)' and Consultation shows only 'dr. Rina Putri (doctor)'. Time dropdown populates from availability API. Existing pytest suites had 5 pre-existing failures unrelated to iter10 (stale bookings + trial-clock drift).

minor.issue: test_bookings.py::TestPublicCreateBooking::test_create_booking_and_conflict_409, test_wa_sent_persists_history, test_cantik_booking_not_visible_to_glow all fail because leftover bookings from previous iterations occupy the specific future slots those tests target. Now that capacity=1 is enforced, the FIRST call in those tests returns 409 instead of 200. Pure test-data hygiene, not a code regression — the iter10 capacity logic is working as designed. Suggested fix: randomise the scheduled_at in those tests.

test_saas.py::TestSeededLogins[owner@renaskin.id] and TestRenaTrialCountdown expect Rena Skin subscription_status='trial' but it is now 'active'. Trial clock appears to have flipped or seed changed. Pre-existing, unrelated to iter10.

issues: DATE field uses native HTML5 <input type="date"> (browser-default picker) instead of shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere in the app — minor visual inconsistency.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — the option text wrapper inserts a <span> inside <option>. Functionally works but pollutes console. Likely an x-source instrumentation/dev-only wrapper.
